mentions.note: brother of Percy Wilson; co-donor of the Wilson Shield

61-year-old walker, joined Belgrave September 1939; National 50 km 1947-49 best 5h.12m.30s; 14 London to Brighton races, all inside 10 hours; 2nd Belgravian in 1947 (9h.27m.40s); former footballer and ballroom dancer; 1950 Brighton best 9h.16m.22s.; Centurion No.164 in 1951 Brighton and Back (21h.59m.30s.); hit by a car in the 1957 'Brighton'; attendant to Dickie Green on 10 occasions
